annotations.title: Remove an item from a queue

description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] DESTRUCTIVE: removes an item (the draft stays in the library). A booked (`scheduled`) item is refused (409) unless `unschedule: true`, which deletes its platform post first. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) on the Agency plan or higher.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/queues/{id}/items/{itemId}.)

brandId.description: Account-wide keys: "personal" or an id from GET /api/v2/brands (omitted → the brand last active in the dashboard; required once the account is in more than one organization). A brand-bound key always uses its own brand.

unschedule.description: true: delete the booked post at the platform first (the dashboard's "Unschedule"), then delete. Without it a booked post is a 409 — nothing is ever left booked at the platform without its queue item.

name: remove_queue_item
